paragraphs.text: Emily Teng is a Game Designer for Magic: The Gathering at Wizards of the Coast . She started working for the company in April 2018.

As part of the worldbuilding team, she writes art descriptions, deepens and builds on existing lore, collaborates with Play Design , acts as creative lead on sets, and leads creative text on sets. She provided background Magic Story for Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty .
Duskmourn: House of Horror (also creative lead)
